mcp_tools.name: codebase_structural_query
mcp_tools.title: Codebase structural query
mcp_tools.description: Submit a code-graph index (nodes and typed edges) plus one structural query; get a deterministic graph answer — descendants, ancestors, blast radius, shortest typed path, stats, or snapshot — aggregate-first (counts and kind breakdowns; full node lists only on expand). Never answers from an index declared stale.

inputSchema.description: The graph index plus one query (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the graph and query schemas).

graph.description: The code-graph index: {nodes: [{id, kind}], edges: [{from, to, kind}]}.

index.description: Index metadata: {stale: bool} — a stale index is never answered from.

expect.notes: Valid structural query returning aggregate counts. computed_spot_checks: nodes_count=2, edges_count=1, descendants_of_A=1.
